comment: Wired jigs for this project. Mode: warn (reports) → block (refuses) once live violations are cleared. A jig is a fence with a detector. Proposed fences are honored by agents but not yet mechanized — UNJIGGED until wired. mw-gate.sh is always a jig on stock/bench/finished moves.

jigs.fence: Every '<FILE>.md §N' reference resolves to a numbered heading N in that file.
jigs.why: Shop-made. PORTABILITY.md conditioned host conformance on 'SPEC.md §9'; SPEC.md has five sections. The criterion was unresolvable and had survived at least one rewrite.
jigs.not: Deliberately not a path checker: a naive one returns ~43 hits on this corpus of which ~2 are real (schematic placeholders, 'if present' trees, ignore-list examples, gitignored ledgers, prohibitions). That stays a SIGN until a placeholder marker exists.
